Our backlog at the end of the first quarter was a record $4.4 billion. With a number of advanced bookings, our backlog will burn over a longer period and include audits that will be produced in 2024. Industrial customers were 51% of total revenue in the first quarter. Institutional markets, which include education, health care and government, are also strong and represent 28% of our revenue. The commercial sector is active. Construction was 80% of our revenue this quarter, with construction projects for new buildings at 54%, while construction projects in existing buildings was 26%.
